content.text:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Train-level draft lifecycle guard (issue #282, gh-2230): the ci.yml tag
# train is the PUBLISH OWNER of every staged draft (gh-1801 rework — the
# release-provenance job is the sole `--draft=false --latest` flip point),
# but the per-creating-job guards (scripts/release_draft_guard.sh) cover
===
  train-draft-guard:
    name: Train draft lifecycle guard
    needs: release-provenance
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    if: >-
      always() &&
      ((github.event_name == 'push' && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')) ||
      github.event_name == 'release')
    permissions:
      contents: write # delete the orphaned staged draft (issue #282 E2)
      actions: read # probe the draft-owner marker run's status (gh-2008 pattern)
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - name: Delete drafts the failed train will never publish
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PROVENANCE_RESULT: ${{ needs.release-provenance.result }}
        run: bash scripts/release_train_draft_guard.sh "${GITHUB_REF_NAME}"

The issue #282 lifecycle invariant was enforced per creating job only,
but since gh-1801 the staged draft's publish owner is the ci.yml tag
train (release-provenance, the sole publish point). A train failing
upstream of the publish point (core tests -> quality-gate red ->
binaries skipped -> provenance skipped) left the staged draft orphaned
until the 24h sweeper reclaimed it and filed the recurring sweep issue
(v1.0.728 / gh-2230).

New ci.yml train-draft-guard job (needs release-provenance, always(),
tag-push/release events) exports the publish point's settled result and
runs scripts/release_train_draft_guard.sh: delete drafts for the trained
tag whose well-formed ownership marker names a COMPLETED run — only when
that result is 'skipped' (rerun --failed never resurrects skipped jobs).
A failed/cancelled provenance is rerunnable, so the draft stays as the
rerun --failed recovery vessel (gh-1899 convention). Fail-safe keeps:
in-flight owner runs, unmarked/human drafts (E1), lookup failures,
unset result. The 24h sweeper remains the backstop; the git tag is
never touched." && git log --oneline -2

tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the
    # pre-commit gate. Run them manually with: dart test --tags integration
  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only
    # through the dedicated browser-ext.yml workflow (builds sw/agent.js and
    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:
    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are
    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:
    # dart test --tags io
  perf:
    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open
    # budgets. Selected by --tags integration in CI; run standalone with
    # dart test --tags perf
  reg-parity:
    # omp REG parity suite (issue #810): structural diff of the committed
    # omp reference twins vs fa's pure-Dart engine renders. Fast, hermetic
    # (no PTY, no network), SKIPs when the fixtures are not captured yet.
    # Merge-blocking through the EXISTING legs: ci.yml test-core (dart test
    # runs it) and the pty-visual job (fa_omp_reg_visual_test.dart) both
    # aggregate into Quality gate; the pre-commit hook's test-core stage
    # runs the same suite, so hook/CI marker parity holds with no new
    # stage. Standalone: dart test test/cli/omp_reg_parity_test.dart

arguments.content:
### Root Cause

The issue #282 draft lifecycle invariant was enforced only per **creating job** (`release_draft_guard.sh` in the same job as the create), but since gh-1801 the staged draft's publish owner is a different run — the ci.yml tag train's `release-provenance` job (the sole publish flip). For `v1.0.728` the creating run succeeded while the tag train failed upstream of the publish point (Core tests shard → quality-gate red → `binaries` skipped → `release-provenance` skipped): no guarded job failed, the flip never ran, and the draft rotted until the 24h sweeper deleted it and filed the recurring sweep issue.

### Fix

- `scripts/release_train_draft_guard.sh` (new): deletes drafts for the trained tag whose well-formed `release-draft-owner:` marker names a **completed** run — only when the publish point's settled result is `skipped` (unreachable: `rerun --failed` never resurrects skipped jobs). Fail-safe keeps: failed/cancelled provenance (rerunnable → the draft stays as the `rerun --failed` recovery vessel, gh-1899 convention), in-flight owner runs, unmarked/human drafts (E1), lookup failures, unset result. **Root cause:** The #282 draft lifecycle invariant was enforced only per *creating job*, but since gh-1801 the staged draft's publish owner is the ci.yml **tag train** (`release-provenance`, the sole publish flip).
